verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document GitHub's native closing-keyword commit syntax, but it does show an official Atlassian integration that 'unifies data, automates workflows, and syncs development across GitHub, Jira' which implies some issue-status syncing capability from commits/PRs. This is thin, indirect evidence rather than a documented commit-keyword-to-status-update workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of issue-key syntax in commit messages, confirmation that referencing keys auto-transitions ticket status in Jira or other trackers, and independent corroboration of this working end-to-end.
